summary: Northern Dynasty Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report an amended and restated Share Option Plan, effective January 28, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance update, amending a compensation plan for directors, employees, and service providers. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation. The plan caps shares at 8% of outstanding shares and complies with TSX and U.S. tax rules. This is an ordinary equity incentive plan amendment, not a special event requiring M&A or activist analysis.
